svg.title: GPIb–IX–V: HPA-2 on GPIbα
svg.desc: Topology-level carrier cartoons, not identical generic Ig receptors. HPA naming and residue lists must be verified for a specified antigen; total database counts are intentionally omitted. Native editable vector; domain cartoons are not atomic models.
